label: airFiber 2X
description: 2.4 GHz airFiber X carrier backhaul radio (antenna sold separately, AF-2G24-S45). Up to 687 Mbps real throughput and 200+ km range with INVICTUS silicon and HDD TDD; 17 W max, 24 V passive PoE in. Ports: 1x GbE data RJ45 + 1x 10/100 MbE management RJ45, plus RP-SMA RF and GPS antenna connectors.
